name: SK hynix P&T7
summary: An advanced packaging and test plant for HBM and other AI memory that SK hynix is building in the Cheongju Technopolis industrial complex, near its M15X fab. SK hynix announced it in January 2026 at about KRW 19 trillion and broke ground on 22 April 2026. The plans call for about 150,000 m² of cleanroom on a site of about 230,000 m², split between wafer-level packaging lines on three floors and wafer-test lines on seven, with the test lines due by October 2027, the packaging lines by February 2028 and about 3,000 staff once running. In July 2026 the company set aside KRW 20 trillion for P&T7 and other Cheongju facilities and said the plant should be finished by the end of 2027.

location.note: Oebuk-dong, Heungdeok-gu, Cheongju, near SK hynix's M15X fab.

notes: SK hynix calls P&T7 its fifth production facility in Cheongju, after M11, M12, M15 and M15X. The KRW 19 trillion figure and the April 2026 start come from a Korean-language newsroom explainer; the KRW 20 trillion in the July 2026 plan also covers other facilities the company did not name.

review.method: Independent AI-assisted review (Claude): re-opened every cited source, checked each statement against it and searched for newer reporting.
review.changes: Moved the status from announced to under construction on SK hynix's report of the 22 April 2026 groundbreaking, and dated the announcement to its 13 January 2026 explainer, which predates the full-year results the record had treated as the first mention. Added the KRW 19 trillion plant budget, cleanroom and site area, staffing, line completion dates, the industrial-complex site and the construction manager; dropped the full-year 2025 results, the June 2026 explainer, the second-quarter 2026 results and the 2024 M15X release, which the new sources replace.
